# GroupTimestamp { #timetoalign.timelines.GroupTimestamp }

```python
timelines.GroupTimestamp(
    coordinates,
    source_id,
    row_index=-1,
    source=None,
    is_interpolated=False,
    conversion_maps=True,
)
```

A synchronized instant across all timelines in a group.

This is a view object created from a row in the group's timestamp table.
Not stored directly - the table is the source of truth.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name        | Type                                                                        | Description                                                                                                 |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| coordinates | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)\] | Dictionary mapping timeline IDs to canonical coordinates. Null table cells are omitted.                     |
| row_index   | [int](`int`)                                                                | Index of this timestamp in the source table. -1 indicates an interpolated timestamp (not from a table row). |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> ts = group.get_timestamp_at_index(0)
>>> ts.get_coordinate_for("dgt1:1", format="float")
0.0
>>> ts.present_timelines  # Which timelines have values here
['dgt1:1', 'audio:1']
```

### get_conversion_for { #timetoalign.timelines.GroupTimestamp.get_conversion_for }

```python
timelines.GroupTimestamp.get_conversion_for(key)
```

Return a conversion-map value by selector.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                             | Default    |
|--------|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| key    | [str](`str`) | Conversion-map name, ID, selector, or target-unit name. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type               | Description                                |
|--------|--------------------|--------------------------------------------|
|        | [object](`object`) | The map result without numeric projection. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                   | Description                        |
|--------|------------------------|------------------------------------|
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`) | If no eligible conversion matches. |

### get_unit { #timetoalign.timelines.GroupTimestamp.get_unit }

```python
timelines.GroupTimestamp.get_unit(
    unit,
    *,
    timeline_id=None,
    format='id_coordinate',
    rounding='round',
)
```

Get the row coordinate converted to a specific unit.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                              | Description                                  | Default           |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)                     | The target unit for conversion.              | _required_        |
| timeline_id | [str](`str`) \| None                                              | Optional stored member to select explicitly. | `None`            |
| format      | [CoordinateFormat](`timetoalign.core.retrieval.CoordinateFormat`) | Requested coordinate output format.          | `'id_coordinate'` |
| rounding    | [Rounding](`timetoalign.core.retrieval.Rounding`)                 | Integral projection mode.                    | `'round'`         |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                          | Description                      |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
|        | [CoordinateResult](`timetoalign.core.retrieval.CoordinateResult`) \| [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`) | Converted coordinate projection. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                   | Description                                       |
|--------|------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`) | If no selected coordinate or eligible map exists. |
